sloka: एकः कार्याणि कुरुते तम् आहुर् मध्यमम् नरम् ।गुण दोषाव् अनिश्चित्य त्यक्त्वा दैव व्यपाश्रयम् ॥६-६-१०॥।।
transliteration: ekaḥ kāryāṇi kurute tam āhur madhyamam naram ।guṇa doṣāv aniścitya tyaktvā daiva vyapāśrayam ॥6-6-10॥।।

translations.english: "He who fails to consider the merits and de merits, decides to do on his own and begins without faith in god saying, 'I' will do it, is a lowly one among men."
